```python
url_candidates = []
for source in [paper_web_search, leicester_search, repository_search, volume_search, exact_unit_search]:
    if isinstance(source, dict):
        stack = [source]
    elif isinstance(source, list):
        stack = list(source)
    else:
        stack = [source]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            stack.extend(item.values())
        elif isinstance(item, list):
            stack.extend(item)
        elif isinstance(item, str) and ("http" in item or ".pdf" in item):
            url_candidates.append(item)
print(url_candidates[:20])
```
